xiaohongshu_manual_publish_only.rule: Never upload, schedule, or create a Xiaohongshu draft. Generate a validated package and send its text and images to the operator for manual publication only.

rules: Hermes access to domestic channels must use CN_PROXY and must not fall back to the Hermes server public IP.
Hermes access to international channels must use US_PROXY and must not reuse CN_PROXY unless a current ops report explicitly approves a route exception.
Login, cookie refresh, upload, draft, schedule, postcheck, analytics, trend scraping, and crawler probes are all channel access and must follow this proxy policy.
If the required proxy is missing, unreachable, or the observed egress region does not match the channel class, the channel must be blocked before login or upload.
Cookie files created under the wrong egress class are suspect and must be revalidated through the correct proxy before use.
drafts use draft_id as post_id and keep url empty or backend-only
next generation must read unresolved objections before topic selection

douyin.selection_rule: Hermes must execute each account_key as a separate operating object; never treat base platform douyin as a single account when daily ops require Douyin.

weekly_mix.candidate_selection: when fewer works are requested than weekly total, include both lines in the candidate pool and prefer the line with the larger remaining weekly quota

postcheck_contract.anti_duplicate_rule: if user_verified_submission or submit_success evidence exists, block duplicate reupload until management page or user review clears the state
